g.text: Double-barrel shotgun SFX for a bounty-hunter character in a top-
down 1930s cursed-island survival game. Massive low-end thump with
wide pellet scatter texture, shell-eject clink at the tail, close-
range weight that conveys knockback; slight distortion at close
range, clean at mid range. Deliberate, heavy, not rapid-fire
friendly. Deliver 48 kHz WAV, 1.2-1.5 s, plus a shell-eject layer as
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
